labelPolicy.target: Visible rooftop polygons, not ground/base footprints, facades, property or occupancy
labelPolicy.minimumStructure: Approximately5m2 with contextual dwelling exceptions; preserve original labels
labelPolicy.treesAndShadows: Publisher may infer partially obscured roof edges; shadow itself excluded; no new agent inference
labelPolicy.touchingAndOffNadir: Separate touching rooftop instances retained; visible partially occluded and tiered roof labeling can differ from physical building identity
labelPolicy.holesAndClipping: Original rings preserved. Selected178 polygons have0 hole rings;23 exterior rings cross image boundaries and raster masks clip only to source chip extent.
labelPolicy.ignoreAndUncertainty: No authoritative per-pixel ignore mask, feature uncertainty flags or pair-level reviewer/date supplied. These stay absent/unknown; full-frame eligibility is this publisher-label analysis policy.
labelPolicy.independence: Published human labels reviewed under Tier1 policy; no model/provider/agent-generated ground truth. Local independent human audit remains unperformed.
